FAQ
  1. Download Addon “Essential Texture Pack” (or all of them, really)
  2. But why are textures in the separate addon?
    • this way updating code won’t force you to redownload 100+ MB of textures
    • this allows everyone to make their own texture packs and share them on Forge
  3. How can I make my own texture pack?
    • Essential Texture Pack page describes it in detail
  4. What formats are supported?
    • png, mp4 (H.264, H.265), webm (VP8), for more details check Unity docs
  5. gif support?
    • Convert your gifs to videos. If you dont need transparent background, use mp4. Otherwise - webm, just dont forget to set codec to VP8 (VP9 is not supported by Unity). Also compare quality after conversion, some converter websites absolutely destroy gifs on their default settings, so set bitrate high, it will still come out smaller than original gif.
  6. Videos don’t play audio?
    • Check Play Audio setting in F12/7Bpencil.WeaponCamoAndStickers menu, but it won’t work as you expect because of technical challenges
  7. I don’t see camo editor
    • Click APPLY PAINT or CHANGE MATERIAL button in item interaction menu (they are located after DISCARD button and require Workbench Level 1)
  8. I managed to paint left and right side, but how do I paint top?
    • There are multiple tools to do it:
      1. Try MaxAngle slider, get a feeling how it works, setting MaxAngle to 0 will cover everything at the expense of stretching (but it may look fine in your case)
      2. Select Move tool, look at green arrow, decal is projected in direction opposite to it. This means you can rotate decal to face any surface you want to paint. Left/Right is just handy shortcuts to set decal position/rotation/scale certain way
      3. Use Mask, it will break up pattern and make cutoff line less noticable
      4. Try Material Editor, in some cases it can give much better results
  9. Stickers on armor/backpack/rig/helmet?
    • Nope, equipment is entirely different, much more complicated beast, and I don’t want to torture myself any further.
  10. Keep some weapon parts completely clean from paint?
    • Maybe in the future
  11. Keep paint attached to moving weapon parts (magazine, pistol slide, folding stock, etc)? Apply paint on part-by-part basis?
    • Not happening. I have a working prototype, but it tanks fps and can break other mods, and sadly those issues can not be solved. If you really want it, you can compile part-by-part branch from source.
  12. Any keybinds to speed up edit process?
    • Check F12/7Bpencil.WeaponCamoAndStickers
  13. Undo system?
    • 😭
  14. I changed something and camo is now looking weird and its sliding across weapon surface
    • You made decal box too big. Try to scale it down (especially in green axis)
  15. Editor UI is too small / too big
    • Check UI Scale setting in F12/7Bpencil.WeaponCamoAndStickers menu
  16. Do items returned by insurance retain their paint/material changes?
    • Nope, they are technically copies with different ids. Haven’t worked on synchronizing it
  17. Material changes on clothes are not visible in first person?
    • First person hands are technically completely different model with separate set of materials and meshes
  18. I noticed some items cannot be edited with material editor, why?
    • Material Editor works only on standard BSG opaque materials, so transparent materials and some others are not supported, the same with modded items that use custom shaders (like some Epics guns). Reason: supporting even one material type is complicated enough
  19. Fika Headless compatibility?
    • Headless client requires bundles folder and all dlls, but addons are not necessary. Keep in mind, camos on AI guns are randomly generated by host from available textures, which means if headless client has no textures, there won’t be camos on AI guns.
  20. What mods have you used in the video?
    • Brighter Interiors
    • CloudSix - Volumetric Clouds
    • Smajlec’s Lights

versions.description: - Fixed scrolling for users with non default UIScale
- Added ability to put stickers on clothes, armors, rigs, backpacks

- Fixed bots missing randomly painted guns
- Fixed secure container not being counted as container

- Added ability to put stickers on Knives, Helmets, Facemasks, Containers
- Scrolling textures will no longer zoom item in/out for UIFixes users (thanks to pein)

- Improved lighting on items with changed textures
- Added new preset system for Material Editor that saves all changed materials on item and subitems
- Minor UI fixes
- Fixed Fika support for Material Editor (thanks to @cranberryAmy for bug report)

- Added RGB hex code text fields to all color variables
- Added option to spawn scavs with painted guns (default chance is 0)
- Optimized editor UI, hopefully it will be less laggy
- Removed excessive logging

- Fixed oily sheen which was very noticable on some items
- Added "Advanced Settings" tab in Material Editor
- Some minor UI fixes and improvements
- Fixed clothes editor breaking character creation screen (thanks to @Gleneth for finding it)

all_versions.description: • Ported to SPT 4.1.*
• Fixed scrolling for users with non default UIScale
• Added ability to put stickers on clothes, armors, rigs, backpacks

• Fixed bots missing randomly painted guns
  • Fixed secure container not being counted as container

• Added ability to put stickers on Knives, Helmets, Facemasks, Containers
  • Scrolling textures will no longer zoom item in/out for UIFixes users (thanks to pein)

• Improved lighting on items with changed textures
  • Added new preset system for Material Editor that saves all changed materials on item and subitems
  • Minor UI fixes
• Fixed Fika support for Material Editor (thanks to @cranberryAmy for bug report)

• Added RGB hex code text fields to all color variables
  • Added option to spawn scavs with painted guns (default chance is 0)
  • Optimized editor UI, hopefully it will be less laggy
  • Removed excessive logging

• Fixed oily sheen which was very noticable on some items
  • Added “Advanced Settings” tab in Material Editor
  • Some minor UI fixes and improvements
• Fixed clothes editor breaking character creation screen (thanks to @Gleneth for finding it)
• Added ability to change material on clothes (thanks to @letmedowneasy for the idea)
• Added ability to link multiple materials to synchronize changes (thanks to @erti for the idea)
• Material Editor now shows items from all slots (thanks to @TheAlexJ for the idea)

• Fixed rain resetting material changes (again)
  • Fixed some cases of material changes not visible on inventory icons (again)
  • Please tell me if issues still persist

• Fixed rain resetting material changes
  • Fixed some cases of material changes not visible on inventory icons
• Skip null materials

• Check new video in description
  • Added material editor that works on every item (thanks to @erti for idea and first working prototype)
  • Added separate “APPLY PAINT” and “CHANGE MATERIAL” buttons
  • Added ability to mark textures as favourite (right-click)
• Eraser can use mask now (thanks to @TacticalNekoYuki for convincing me)

• Added special “Eraser” type decal that hides decals above it (now you can keep your mags clean from paint)
  • Inventory icons now properly display camo
  • Fixed preset name field allowing special characters that led to invalid filenames
  • Moving last decal down will make it first, moving first decal up will make it last

Note to Fika users: Fika Support addon is now bundled together with Main mod, filenames are the same, no actions needed from your side (thanks to GrooveypenguinX for showing me better way to setup fika support). Forge page was removed, if for some reason you need older version, you can download it from github releases.
• Reduced scope of copy/paste button

• Added button to hide/show decal (thanks to @Bandoot for idea)
  • Added button to mirror decal without creating separate duplicate decal (thanks to @Bandoot for reminding me)
  • Added button to copy/paste decal texture data (thanks to @Bandoot for idea)
  • Don’t forget to update Fika Support addon

• Bosses and AI PMC guns can now spawn with randomly generated camos (good time to download all addons for variety)
  • Added button Generate Random Camo under Show Presets
  • Do not forget to update Fika Support addon
• Some videos on some systems get stuck loading infinitely, added load time limit to mark such videos broken before they create a problem
• Forgot that FileInfo constructor can throw exceptions too
• Gracefully handle file system access errors

• Fika support (thanks to @GetParanoid)
  • Animated textures (.mp4 and .webm support)
  • Added folders UI
  • Fixed high RAM/VRAM consumption (thanks to @GetParanoid)

CHANGES:

  • Added “UI Scale” setting (Check F12 menu)
  • Fixed decals not being visible in optics

CHANGES:

  • Added Move and Rotate UV
  • Returned “mirror left/right” button (previously called “flip left/right”)
  • Renamed “flip side” button to “flip dir”
  • Fixed camo not visible on EDIT BUILD screen
  • Fixed error when modifying weapon with opened preview window
  • Fixed decal name being reset in some cases

CHANGES:

  • Added option to change decal name (thanks Razolak for the idea)
  • Added buttons to flip decal horizontally and vertically (thanks Baconism for reminding me)
  • Moving last decal down the list now makes it first. Moving first decal up the list makes it last
  • Renamed Hotkeys to Keybinds

HOW TO UPDATE FROM 1.0.1:

  • Download new version and unzip as usual
  • All addons should work fine

HOW TO UPDATE FROM 1.0.0:

  1. Move folder 7Bpencil.WeaponCamoAndStickers from SPT/user/mods to BepInEx/plugins
  2. Download new version and unzip as usual
  3. No need to update addons, you already moved all of them on step 1
  4. Sorry for the inconvenience

CHANGES:

  • Fixed warning “No Assemblies found in path…”
  • Fixed error caused by Flexible Builds mod (please report if you still have issues)
Initial release
